Market today: The mood is cautious, with Fed speak hinting at no immediate rate cuts, which tends to pressure growth names. Your concentrated tech/chip book, especially on margin, feels this pressure acutely.
Your holdings: SMCI (-20.03%), MUU (-26.06%), SOXL (-52.24%), SPAL (-35.19%), and SMH (-12.18%) are all in the red and flagged for attention. These leveraged and chip-focused names are taking a hit.
Watch: Keep an eye on QQQ and SPY for broader market direction, and monitor the leveraged ETFs like SOXL and SPAL for signs of stabilization or further downside.
Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged and chip positions, as they are currently the most vulnerable.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL and SPAL further if they show continued weakness below their current levels.
Watch SMCI and SMH stops closely; a break below could signal more pain.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
